name: storybook-figma-mcp

tools.name: list_storybook_tools
tools.description: List all tools available on the connected Storybook MCP server. Use this first to discover what the Storybook MCP exposes.

tools.name: call_storybook_tool
tools.description: Call any tool on the connected Storybook MCP server and return its raw response. Use list_storybook_tools first to see what tools are available.

tool.description: The Storybook MCP tool name to call

args.description: Arguments to pass to the tool (as a JSON object)

tools.name: list_figma_tools
tools.description: List all tools available on the connected Figma MCP server.

tools.name: call_figma_tool
tools.description: Call any tool on the connected Figma MCP server and return its raw response. Use list_figma_tools to see what tools are available.

tool.description: The Figma MCP tool name to call

args.description: Arguments to pass to the tool (as a JSON object)

tools.name: get_component_context
tools.description:
Bridge tool: calls both the Storybook MCP and Figma MCP in parallel, then merges their responses into a single ComponentContext object (schema: storybook-figma-mcp/v2).

Provide:
- storybookTool + storybookArgs to call any Storybook MCP tool (use list_storybook_tools to discover them)
- figmaNodeId to fetch design context and tokens from Figma

Both sources are optional — you can call with only one if needed.
Returns one unified JSON with storybook and figma data side by side.

storybookTool.description: The Storybook MCP tool to call (e.g. 'get-story', 'get-component'). Use list_storybook_tools to discover available tools.

storybookArgs.description: Arguments to pass to the Storybook MCP tool

figmaNodeId.description: Figma node ID (e.g. '1:2' from the Figma URL node-id=1-2)

figmaFileKey.description: Figma file key (from the Figma URL). Required for remote Figma MCP.

includeTokens.description: Also fetch Figma design tokens (colors, spacing, typography). Default: true.
